fig1_negbinom_pmf.svg: Negative binomial pmf P(X=x)=C(x-1,r-1)(1-p)^{x-r} p^r for p=0.3 and r=1,2,3 (bars, from negbinom_pmf). X counts the trials to the r-th success; r=1 is the geometric law, and the mean r/p moves right with r.
fig2_memoryless_tail.svg: Geometric survival P(X>n)=(1-p)^n (bars, from geometric_sf) and the conditional tail P(X>5+n | X>5) (orange dots, from memoryless_check) for p=0.3. They coincide: having waited 5 trials does not change the future.
